⇒ gate **CLOSED**. ⛔ No p2/p3 工具卡 or 契约卫生卡. ⭐ This is neither: it is an **authoring surface
an admin uses** — the condition editor's subject vocabulary — where offering the wrong subjects
produces an expression the host will refuse at write time. The card carries a `bug` type from triage.

### Premise RE-DERIVED at source by this seat, ⛔ not relayed

On `origin/main` tip `4dbab84d4`, 取数时刻 2026-09-19T12:33:37Z:
`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/conditionScope.ts` exports
`CONDITION_SCOPE_BY_METADATA_TYPE` and `conditionScopeForMetadataType`, and the co-located pin
`ConditionWidget.conditionScope.test.tsx` asserts `action`, `validation` **and** `hook` all resolve to
`'record'`. ⇒ ⭐ the table yields a **SCOPE**, not a **CONTEXT**: one `'record'` value covering two
different binding sets. PR objectui#9949 — the sibling repair for the two **curated** mounts — is
landed, verified at `aced50d2e`.

### ⭐⭐ The first deliverable is a MEASUREMENT that may END the card

The card's own 「NOT MEASURED」 block says nobody has established that a **server-evaluated** condition
reaches the generic mount at all today. Triage turned that into deliverable #1 and added a
same-direction reading it found in the file's own comment on `validation`: 「today it has **no live
host through this table**」 — the standard kind is retired under ADR-0088, `ResourceEditPage` never
legitimately receives it, and an object's embedded rules go through `EmbeddedItemEditor`, **which
builds no `WidgetContext` at all**.

⇒ the dispatch is explicit: measure reachability first; if it is zero, ⛔ **stop and report** rather
than repair. ⭐ A repair built on an unreachable path is worse than none. And if it is non-zero, the
repair is a **per-metadata-type context derivation** — ⛔ not a third copy of the one-line
declaration objectui#9949 gave the curated mounts.

### ⚠️ Cross-repo reading, declared up front

The binding sets live in `objectstack`'s `packages/objectql/**`. The dev is told it may **read** that
repo to derive them and must re-derive rather than quote the card — and ⛔ may not change anything
there. A defect found in `objectstack` is a separate card in `objectstack`, reported to this seat,
⛔ never a rider on this PR.

### Declared file surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/**` and co-located tests, one `.changeset/` entry.
⛔ OUT: `SearchResultsPage.tsx` and `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (objectui#9664 in flight);
`packages/app-shell/package.json` (held by open PR objectui#8941); `pnpm-lock.yaml` (H17 trigger:
objectui#8348, objectui#9868); and ⛔ repairing machine-locale `Intl` sites anywhere —
`packages/app-shell` carries 14 in objectui#9909's census and that card is `pm:blocked` on an unruled
gate question.

### 在飞相交检查 — batch now **3/3**

This seat's live cards, read at 取数时刻 2026-09-19T12:33:37Z: objectui#9664 and
objectui#9430 (`packages/plugin-charts/src/**`). ⚠️ objectui#9664 **is** in `packages/app-shell` —
⇒ the two surfaces are disjoint **by file**: #9664 owns `src/views/SearchResultsPage.tsx`, this card
owns `src/views/metadata-admin/**`, and each dispatch fences the other out **by name**. ⛔ No shared
file.

### ⭐ 可达性测量:答案是 **POSITIVE**,所以这张卡没有停在测量上

派发令把「服务端求值的条件今天到底够不够得着泛型挂载点」定为第一交付物,并写明**读到零就停手**。
dev 两路量,结论是**够得着**,路线是 `hook`:`registerBuiltinPreviews` **没有**注册 `hook` 的 preview,
而 `registerBuiltinInspectors` **有** `registerMetadataDefaultInspector('hook', HookDefaultInspector)`;
而整个 inspector 面板坐在 `PreviewComponent ?` 分支里 ⇒ 那条 curated 路**根本不跑**,`condition` 经
`SchemaForm` 的命名约定落到泛型 `ConditionWidget`。

⭐⭐ 最有力的是**同一次跑出来的 ablation 控制**:在那个真实宿主上,主语下拉读出
`['user.id','user.email','user.role','user.isAdmin']` ⇒ **今天真的在一个可达的服务端求值挂载点上提供
宿主不绑定的主语**。⇒ 分诊的升级判据是被**测量**满足的,⛔ 不是被论证满足的。

| 读数 | 前 | 后 |
|:--|--:|--:|

| `CONDITION_HOST_BY_METADATA_TYPE` | **0** | **6** |
| `conditionSubjects` | **0** | **16** |
| ⭐ **控制** `inspectors/HookDefaultInspector.tsx` | md5 `9d966617…` | **同一个 md5** |
| ⭐ **控制** `inspectors/ConditionBuilder.tsx` | md5 `588b12be…` | **同一个 md5** |

⇒ 新增的三样都在,而**两个 curated inspector 侧的文件逐字节未动** ⇒ 修法确实是「加一个兄弟」,
⛔ 不是「改动既有那条一行声明」。

⭐ **不是第二份字面量**:`conditionScope.ts:3` 是 `import { RECORD_CONDITION_SUBJECTS } from
'./inspectors/ConditionBuilder.js';`,`:272` 直接返回它 —— 与 `HookDefaultInspector` 用的是**同一个对象**,
而新测试钉的是 `toBe(...)`(**同一性**),⛔ 不是深相等。⇒ 没有可以漂移的第二处声明。

### ⛔ 本席第四次把控制词选错 —— 同一个家族,写下来以免再犯

先用 `sed` 按 `/CONDITION_SCOPE_BY_METADATA_TYPE = {/,/^} as const/` 取原表体比对,两个 ref 读出
**31 vs 34** 条,看着像原表被动了。⛔ 不是:这次改动在文件**顶部插了 2 行 import**,又在中部插了一大块,
⇒ 任何**按行号或行区间**取样的探针都会滑位。

⭐ 正确的控制是 **diff 自己的形状**:`diff` 只给出 `2a3,4` 与 `166a169,273` —— **全是 `a`(插入)**,
⛔ 没有一个 `c`(修改)、⛔ 没有一个 `d`(删除)。⇒ 既有的每一行都逐字节原样保留,31 条 scope 条目在内。

⇒ 教训一句:**在一个长出了行的文件上,按行号/行区间取样的探针不是控制词;diff 的形状(`a` 对 `c`/`d`)才是。**
本班四次控制词失手全属同一家族(文件自身行数、滑进新增内容的 `grep -A N`、这次的 `sed` 区间),已记进座位贴。

### 围栏守住了

PR 文件清单 **5 个**,全部在 `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/**` 加一条 `.changeset/`。
⛔ 没有 `SearchResultsPage.tsx`(objectui#9664 当时在飞)、⛔ 没有 `packages/app-shell/package.json`
(开放 PR objectui#8941 持有)、⛔ 没有 `pnpm-lock.yaml`(H17)、⛔ 没有一处 machine-locale `Intl` 修复
(objectui#9909 的普查面)。跨仓侧只读不写:objectstack 只被 fetch 与读取。

### 留下的一条,已由 dev 点名、⛔ 本卡不并入

dev 报的 (c) 类:`EmbeddedItemEditor` 渲染它的 `SchemaForm` 时**完全不给 `widgetContext`**,而
`__object_validation` 锚的 `editAs: 'validation'` 正是打开它的入口 ⇒ 对象内嵌校验规则的 `condition`
在**没有 lint scope** 的情况下被编写。⚠️ dev **刻意没有**就地修:给那个编辑器一个 WidgetContext 会同时
移动 `field` / `index` 两层,而那两层**没有读数**。⇒ 形状未钉,归下一张卡。

### 结项

本卡已由合并自动关为 `completed`。本席同一笔摘掉 `pm:dispatched` 与 assignee;
归属(`bug` / `domain:ui` / `priority:p3`)留下。
